name: pyatv-sdrift-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pyatv, an asyncio client library for Apple TV and AirPlay devices:
device scanning and configuration, HAP pairing and credential storage, the Companion protocol and its
OPACK encoding, and shared support utilities (caches, buffers, collections, variable-length integers,
URL helpers).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the pyatv package except: pyatv/protocols/airplay/, pyatv/protocols/dmap/, pyatv/protocols/mrp/, pyatv/protocols/raop/ and pyatv/scripts/; that is the top-level modules, pyatv/auth/, pyatv/core/, pyatv/storage/, pyatv/support/, pyatv/protocols/__init__.py and the Companion protocol package pyatv/protocols/companion/, together with the page docs/documentation/protocols.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is that page and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with no network access, and no Apple TV or other device is
